notes.policy: A ratchet, not a target. Values are the measured baseline rounded DOWN. They are only ever raised (python scripts/quality_gate.py --ratchet) and never lowered without a reviewed reason.
notes.python_measure: coverage.py with branch coverage over app/; percent = (covered statements + covered branches) / (statements + branches).
notes.critical_modules: core/security.py, policy_service.py and the workflow service/API carry their own, higher floors.
notes.exclusions: None are configured. The code that talks to the real Claude SDK (agent/service.py) is measured but has no separate floor: it is exercised through a scripted SDK client, not a live model.
notes.frontend_exclusions: src/test/** and src/main.tsx (the one-line bootstrap that only mounts <App/>).
